interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven development with policy gates, semantic memory, and multi-agent orchestration
interface.longDescription: The SDD Harness enforces a spec-first methodology: requirements before design, design before code, code before commit. It bundles semantic skill retrieval, vector-indexed memory with annealing, spec-gate policy enforcement, cross-session continuity, and a multi-agent Manager-Executor-Auditor loop. Works across Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Kiro.
